_readme: Queue written by the daily-reel-render task, drained by tools/apply_additions.py during tools/sync.bat. The task must NOT edit calendar.md or review-state.json directly - it queues here instead, and sync.bat folds these in AFTER pulling, on top of whatever the desk decided today. That is what stops the two files conflicting. Adds only: an existing calendar row (keyed on date + post title) is left exactly as the desk left it, and so is an existing review-state key - with one exception, the render flip (content: awaiting-render or rerender -> in-review, plus new revisions entries), which is what tells the desk a cut now exists. It can never write an approval; see the module docstring in tools/apply_additions.py.

revisions.changed: Fixed the missing opening quote on slide 6. Not a typo: the script and the emitted SVG both carried both quotes. ImageMagick 6 lowers each <text> element into an MVG `text x,y "..."` primitive whose payload is itself double-quoted, so a double-quote at the start of the character data collides with that opening delimiter and is dropped; quotes anywhere else survive, which is why the same word renders correctly in the body two lines below. Slide 6 line 3 is the first line in 21 reels to begin with one. render_v3.py gained _payload(), which wraps a payload starting with " in a <tspan> so the quote is no longer first after the delimiter; every other element emits byte-identical SVG. Verified against " (fails identically), a leading zero-width space (works, leaves an invisible character in approved copy) and curly quotes (works, changes the glyph). No word of the approved script changed. Nine scenes, exact CFR via encode.py, 29.53s, layout 0 problems, longest sustained dull-orange run 0.20s. v1 archived as reel21-foul-infraction-violation.v1.mp4.
